column1: # Worked-example rollout verdicts for packages that carry NO tags (@PLN141).
# Hand-written, one row per package:  package <TAB> exempt|deferred <TAB> reason
# exempt   — no function here teaches more from a call site than from its signature.
# deferred — one DOES owe an example, but not in this pass; the reason names what
#            unblocks it, and the monthly by-hand review (LIBRARY_DOC_REVIEW.md) is
# A package that is neither tagged nor listed here is TODO and holds the repo's PR.
# Read the current state with, from a loft checkout:
# NOTHING HERE IS `exempt`.  This is the largest repo in the ecosystem — fourteen
# packages, ~478 public functions — and it is geometry, which is the tier where a
# call site teaches most.  The first pass took the tier-1 package (`hex_grid`, the
# convention every other one is expressed in) and `hex_world`; `hex_form` (Phase E row 1)
# empties this file: every package in the repo now carries worked examples.
